title: New Bone Host Leaders
summary: Bone Host child and dog leader traits were revised, two named leaders changed, and Feast received a base-unit fix.
impact: Bone Host leader planning should be rechecked before carrying an older trait assumption into a run.

title: Rod Art Adjusted
summary: The Rod of Many Tales artwork dimensions were corrected for in-game display.

title: Gear Art & Evaluation Updates
summary: Hammer and Rod art changed; Bian of the Eagle support values and Rod evaluation behavior were updated.
impact: Shop and AI evaluations should better recognize spell-focused Rod pairings.

title: New Gear & Combat Tempo
summary: Rod of Many Tales and Bian of the Eagle were added alongside staff changes and stun-movement timing fixes.
impact: INT builds gained new gear choices while movement after stuns became more consistent.

title: Combat & UI Polish
summary: Frostfall, Ward, several units, charms, and combat presentation received balance or clarity changes.
impact: Older Frostfall timing and several unit baselines should not be treated as current.
